div.div: 4 أَعْبَسَتِ الإِبِلُ The camels had dried urine and dung clinging upon their tails; (S, O, K;) as also ↓ عَبِسَت , inf. n. عَبَسٌ; (A'Obeyd, TA;) whence, (TA,) عَبِسَتْ فِى أَبْوَالِهَا وَأَبْعَارِهَا, [meaning the same,] a phrase occurring in a trad. (O, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
